jobs.description: About Us_ // At Masabi , we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel. Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit. Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what. The Role_ // At Masabi, we're building technology that makes public transport simpler, fairer and more accessible for millions of people. Behind every agency that runs on our platform is a commercial agreement someone had to shape, negotiate and close. As our Legal Counsel, you'll work closely with our General Counsel, leading on our largest and most complex commercial deals. Much of the work follows one opportunity from beginning to end. It starts with major tenders and public procurements, where you'll shape our position on the terms we can work with and the ones worth challenging. From there you'll take the deal through negotiation to signature, with colleagues across the business bringing the commercial and technical detail. Underneath runs the advisory side: data protection and privacy, IP and licensing, and the questions that come with operating across several markets. jobs.title: Engineering Manager (Hands-On, Product Engineering)
jobs.description: REMATIQ is building AI software that helps life sciences and medical device companies bring products to market faster, without compromising the quality, traceability and compliance their industry demands. We turn hundreds of pages of complex regulations, like MDR and FDA guidance, into structured, actionable requirements that plug directly into our customers' development and quality processes. We work with leading companies including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun and Novartis, and have recently closed our Series A. About the job We're growing from one engineering group into dedicated teams, and we're looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead one of them: the team behind our core customer workflows, such as requirements formulation, document comparison, compliance checks and the AI agents that support regulatory and quality experts. This is a player-coach role. You'll lead a team of around six engineers, including product and ML engineers, and you'll stay close enough to the code to make good technical calls, review designs and step in when it matters. You won't be managing from the sidelines. You'll work closely with the team's product owner and designer, and report to the Head of Engineering. We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week. What you'll do Own the team's outcomes. Make sure what the team ships works for customers: quality, reliability, delivery and the long-term health of the system. Lead and grow people. Run 1:1s, give direct feedback, help engineers grow their scope, and build a team where people hold outcomes, not tickets. Hire. Help us grow the team with people who raise the bar. Make delivery predictable. Work with product on priorities, own how the work is sequenced, and keep commitments to customers realistic and kept. Hold the gaps. Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability. We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators. jobs.title: Mobility and Compliance Lead
jobs.description: Mission Neko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne. In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. We design and build our own hardware, software and clinical protocols, and more than 100,000 members have already had a scan, with 75% booking and prepaying their next one before they leave. As a team, we chase 10X, not 10%, and we’re looking for people who think the same way to help us scale what we’ve started in Sweden, the UK, and now the US. Join the clinicians, engineers and business builders making prevention a routine part of care. Role Purpose We are looking for a Mobility and Compliance Lead to be the champion of mobility policy and compliance across Neko as we scale. You will make sure that everyone who joins Neko from another country, relocates between our locations, or works across borders for us can do so lawfully and with a seamless experience, and that the business is never exposed to right-to-work, immigration or cross-border employment risk. This role sits at the point where detail meets people. You will get into the detail of immigration rules, relocation packages and cross-border obligations, and you will be the visible, reassuring face of mobility for candidates, new joiners, employees and leaders. When the answer is no, or not by that date, you will say so clearly, explain why, and show what the compliant alternatives are. You will lead through ownership, expertise and influence, working closely with People Enablement, Rewards, Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, Finance, Legal and our external advisers. jobs.title: Rekrutmen Legal Counsel PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk
jobs.description: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk adalah sebuah badan usaha milik negara Indonesia yang menyediakan berbagai macam jasa keuangan. Bank yang berkantor pusat di Jakarta ini adalah salah satu bank terbesar di Indonesia dalam hal jumlah aset, pinjaman, dan simpanannya. Bank Mandiri didirikan pada 2 Oktober 1998, sebagai bagian dari program restrukturisasi perbankan yang dilaksanakan oleh pemerintah Indonesia. Pada bulan Juli 1999, empat bank pemerintah yaitu Bank Bumi Daya, Bank Dagang Negara, Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia dan Bank Pembangunan Indonesia dilebur menjadi Bank Mandiri, dimana masing-masing bank tersebut memiliki peran yang tak terpisahkan dalam pembangunan perekonomian Indonesia. Sampai dengan hari ini, Bank Mandiri meneruskan tradisi selama lebih dari 140 tahun memberikan kontribusi dalam dunia perbankan dan perekonomian Indonesia.
